articles.summary: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.
articles.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI

articles.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying

articles.summary: When Pony Ma called Tencent Holdings Ltd.’s AI endeavor “a leaky ship” this summer, the billionaire founder sent ripples through a company that for years dominated the industry with WeChat. The social media and gaming leader was at the time struggling to catch the likes of DeepSeek in the post-ChatGPT age. One of his key lieutenants, Dowson Tong, came up with a surprising answer: let’s retool to focus on businesses.
articles.title: Tencent’s Cloud Boss Plays Long Game to Fix ‘Leaky’ AI Ship
